short: Copying particle coordinates and clearing them by measurement

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.XMeasLinearCleanStep.subspaceStep_xUnloadCzPairsSeqDyn
lean.plain: X-basis reset of an ancilla holding a parity of products
lean.annotation: On a normalized input $\sum_x a_x|x\rangle|f(x)\rangle$, each $X$-basis outcome $m$ has probability $1/2$. The data amplitudes after measurement are $a_x(-1)^{mf(x)}$. For $m=1$, a $CZ$ for each pair in the parity supplies the same sign and cancels it, and a conditional $X$ resets the destination. The continuation receives the original data state coherently.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.WalkCostStack.htUsel_stack
lean.plain: 30,116 T-gate bound for an uncontrolled walk step
lean.annotation: The uncomputation follows the potential operation once per walk step and clears the coordinates of the coherently selected pair. Both walk budgets include the same $24{,}194+908$ T allowance for copying and clearing the coordinates.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.XMeasLinearCleanStep.count_xUnloadCzPairsSeqDyn
lean.plain: Zero T gates for one-bit X-basis uncomputation
lean.annotation: Applying the phase $(-1)^{c_i x_i}$ uses a $CZ$ on $c_i$ and $x_i$. The product of these Clifford gates gives the phase for the full parity. Each measurement branch contributes zero T gates and zero primitive Toffoli gates before the continuation `rest`. The selection bits are inputs to this step.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.Stage5W298.counts_pStage5AlwaysLoInPlaceW298_908
lean.annotation: The equalities here apply to the full coordinate uncomputation subroutine. Its circuits for the low electron bits, shared high bits and low nuclear bits contribute $368+452+88=908$ T gates, with zero primitive Toffoli gates. The zero-cost result for the one-bit parity correction applies to that correction alone.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.XMeasLinearCleanStep.subspaceStep_xUnloadCzPairsSeqDyn
lean.plain: X-basis reset of an ancilla holding a parity of products
lean.annotation: The potential is diagonal in the position basis, so it can be applied using copies of the selected coordinates. A copied bit can take the form $\bigoplus_i c_i x_i$, where $c_i$ indicates the selected particle and $x_i$ is that particle’s coordinate bit. A parity of products is the form assumed by the one-ancilla uncomputation lemma.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.PhotochemistrySolution.WalkCostStack.htUsel_stack
lean.plain: 30,116 T-gate bound for an uncontrolled walk step
lean.annotation: The two coordinate loaders contribute 19,156 and 5,038 T gates, giving 24,194 for copying. The next term, 908, is the cost of clearing the copies. Those terms account for the 25,102 T gates that Appendix H.4 assigns to coordinate routing.
